fields.acceptance: A table test in internal/daemon/pick_test.go for a pure Skips function beside Pick covers live, failed-not-cleared, held and no-slot, and shows abandoned or retried failures are not skipped; an internal/api test shows daemonCandidates also reports backlog, not-ready and no-leaves skips
fields.statement: At each poll the daemon works out, for every accepted change set it does not start, a fixed reason (serves no milestone, no leaves, not ready with its readiness reasons, live, failed and not cleared, held, start not journaled, waiting for a slot) and saves the list in its state file

fields.acceptance: daemon-status.txtar sets up an accepted change set serving no milestone, one with no leaves and one depending on an unlanded change set, runs daemon --once, and checks Skipped: lines with serves no milestone and the JSON skipped list with reason not-ready and its reasons; describe-golden.txtar is regenerated
fields.statement: rhiza daemon status and its --json list each skipped change set by ID and title with its reason, and its readiness reasons when it is not ready, as of the daemon's last poll
